cards.text: John is writing a letter to believers he calls his little children. He's just told them that if anyone does sin, Jesus Christ is their advocate before the Father. Now he takes on a BIG question: how can you be SURE you've come to know Him?

cards.question: How does John say we can be sure we've come to know Him?

answers.text: If we feel close to Him
If we learn all about Him

cards.text: Now John flips it around. If anyone says, "I know Him," but doesn't keep His commandments, John has something to say about that person.

cards.question: Someone says, "I know Him," but doesn't keep His commandments. John says that person is a ___.
True or false: John says the truth is still in the person who claims to know Him but doesn't keep His commandments.

cards.text: But if anyone keeps His word, John says the love of God has been truly perfected in him.
Then John gives a way to know we're in Him. And just like with "I know Him," claiming it isn't enough.

cards.question: John says anyone who claims to abide in Him must walk a certain way. How?

cards.text: Then John calls them "Beloved" and tells them about the commandment he's writing.

cards.question: True or false: John says the commandment he's writing is one they've had from the beginning.

cards.text: Then John turns right around and says he IS also writing them a new commandment. Old AND new, kind of like me: same old stamper from the junk drawer, made brand new.

cards.question: John says the new commandment is true in Him and also in you. What does he say is happening with the darkness and the light?

answers.text: The darkness is fading and the light is shining
The darkness is gone and the light is coming
The darkness and the light are at war

cards.text: Now John says: if anyone claims to be in the light but hates his brother... I bet John's raising an eyebrow here, and with eyebrows like mine, friend, I KNOW that look.

cards.question: True or false: John says someone who claims to be in the light but hates his brother is on his way out of the darkness.
John says whoever loves his brother has no cause of stumbling in him. Where does John say that person remains?

cards.text: Then the flip side: whoever hates his brother is in the darkness and walks in the darkness, and he doesn't know where he's going. Friend, I spent YEARS in a dark drawer, and I couldn't have found the scissors if they were sitting on my mustache.

cards.question: Whoever hates his brother doesn't know where he's going. Why not, according to John?

answers.text: The darkness has blinded his eyes
No one is showing him the way

cards.text: Next John speaks to his readers group by group: little children, fathers and young men. He gives each group a reason he's writing to them.

cards.question: John writes to the little children because their sins have been ___ through His name.
True or false: John writes to the fathers because they know Him who is from the beginning.
John writes to the young men because of someone they've overcome. Who is it?

cards.text: Then John switches to "I have written," tells the children they know the Father, and circles back to the fathers and the young men. That's me with every new baker at the oven: "It's hot. It's HOT. Friend, it is SO HOT."

cards.question: John tells the young men they are ___, and the word of God abides in them.

cards.text: Then John gets straight to the point, no small talk: do not love the world or anything in the world.

cards.question: If anyone loves the world, what does John say is not in him?

cards.text: John names what's in the world: the desires of the flesh, the desires of the eyes and the pride of life. And the desires of the eyes, friend, that's me staring down a fresh tray of chocolate chip cookies, swearing, "I'm just LOOKING."

cards.question: True or false: John says the desires of the flesh, the desires of the eyes and the pride of life come from the Father.

cards.text: Then John gives the long view: the world is passing away, along with its desires. The world comes with an expiration date, just like the expired coupon I shared that drawer with, and bless him, he STILL believed in himself.

cards.question: The world is passing away. But John says someone remains forever. Who?

answers.text: Whoever does the will of God
